SR MDO och Suspilne: public service media i Ukraina 2024-2027

description.narrative:
Overall development objective:
Strengthening freedom of speech and media pluralism during the war and post-war recovery with reinforced public service media as a tool.
Project objective:
Reinforced, reliable, and trustworthy public service media that contributes to the Ukrainian news ecosystem by strenghtening regional communities, especially in remote areas.
Outcomes:
- Suspilne has improved capacity to remain a reliable and trustworthy public service provider in the media landscape through increased interaction with regional target audiences;
- Maintenance of the digital transformation and further development of the digital ecosystem for a larger public outreach;
- Enhanced effectiveness of Suspilne regional network through bringing of central office and branches to a single nationwide management system and corporate culture.

description.narrative:
Main results achieved and reported and achieved in 2025:
- In 2025, Suspilne had the largest expansion of hyperlocal correspondents network with 12 new regions being covered with Swedish support. As a result of the third wave, as of 31.12.2025, 46 new hyperlocal correspondents were recruited and employed across the 15 regions. All hyperlocal correspondents received production and recording equipment procured within the grant. - Renovations of regional hubs has been one of the largest parts of Suspilne's project in 2025. In 2025, Suspilne completed renovations in Khmelnytskyi. The project encompassed a complete fit-out of all working areas, installation of access control and video surveillance systems, and procurement of furniture and equipment. Renovation of Khmelnytskyi was in accordance with Suspilne Style Guide approved in 2025. PO from Sida took part in opening of a newly renovated office in Khmelnytskyi which Suspilne's top management also attended.
In 2025, Suspilne also renovated premises in Ivano-Frankivsk and Vinnytsia allowing both teams to relocate to new, larger premises and improving their working conditions and expanding production capacity.
In 2025 the project renovated shelving system for Mediatheka Archive in Lviv. Works include acoustic treatment with fibreboard panels, installation of carpet - solutions designed specifically for media production. This infrastructure upgrade ensures that the 3,700 archive items can now be stored safely.
- Digital transformation: In 2025, Suspilne began implementing its Digital Concept 2024-2028. A tangible outcome of this implementation is that all of Suspilne's regional newsrooms launched on TikTok and WhatsApp during the year. Suspilne's news platform suspilne.media was successfully migrated to Amazon Web Services.
- Suspilne also continued ERP and cultural transformations. Throughout 2025, technical preparation for the ERP implementation continued. The technical specification was finalised, and the process of concluding a direct contract with the implementation partner was initiated.
- MediaTrack audience research study confirmed that 73% of Ukrainians are aware of Suspilne and suspilne.media ranks 4th among all Ukrainian news websites by weekly reach.
